Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the specific fix: Bedrock InvokeModel stream message_start now sends null stop_reason and stop_sequence. The raw summary confirms the changelog, the invoke.go change, and the regression test all address this. The title is concise and specific, and it follows the conventional commit style.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description covers the template's main sections: Summary, Changes, Type of change, Affected areas, How to test, Breaking changes, and Related issues. It explains the problem, the code change, the new test, and the changelog entry. It links issue `#9538`. The template's Security considerations and Checklist sections are missing, and the Screenshots section is omitted, which fits a non-UI change. The How to test section gives a single command and no expected outcome for the live check. These gaps are minor.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#9538`] requires `message_start.message` on `/bedrock/model/{id}/invoke-with-response-stream` to include `stop_reason` and `stop_sequence` as JSON null. The whole-PR diff (merge base to head 6c8e974) for `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go` adds `"stop_reason": nil` and `"stop_sequence": nil` to the `msgStart` literal map in `toAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes`. Go encodes nil map values as JSON null, so both keys serialize as null. Existing keys are unchanged. The whole-PR change set also adds `TestToAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes_MessageStartHasNullStopFields` in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go`, which asserts both keys are present and nil. This review re-read the invoke.go diff at head and confirmed the change. The test body was not re-read in this review; its status comes from the change summary and the prior assessment. Not run in this review. The `message_delta` branch is unchanged, which matches the issue scope. No coding requirement from [`#9538`] remains unmet.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR changes are: two nil-valued keys with an explanatory comment in the `message_start` map in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go`; a regression unit test in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go`; a changelog entry in `core/changelog.md`; and an e2e regression case (collection case 383) in `tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json` for the same Bedrock route and fields. The code and unit test implement [`#9538`]. The e2e case and the changelog entry check or document the same behavior, so they support the objective. The `message_delta` branch and `message_start.usage` (the separate concern of [`#5885`]) are not changed. The e2e JSON and changelog were not read directly in this review. Their judgment rests on the change summary. No unrelated change is identified.
